_comment: Genie serialized_space v2 — the shape `databricks api get /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}?include_serialized_space=true` actually returns. Note that every scalar is wrapped in a list, and the key names differ from the bundle examples: text_instructions (not text), example_question_sqls (not benchmarks), column_name (not name).

config.name: Orders & Revenue
description: Marketplace order and revenue questions for growth and finance.

question: What was net revenue last month?
Which product categories drove the most revenue in June?

description: One row per order. All marketplaces, 2021-01-01 onward. Includes test and cancelled orders — filter them out.
One row per SKU per order. Use for product and category cuts only — item revenue excludes shipping.

content: Always exclude test and fraud-blocked orders: is_test = false AND order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud_blocked').
"Last month" means the last complete calendar month, never trailing 30 days.
net_revenue_brl is already refund-adjusted — never subtract refunds again.

question: What was net revenue last month?
sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_brl) FROM analytics.core.fact_orders WHERE is_test = false AND order_status NOT IN ('cancelled','fraud_blocked') AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
